name: L'Hospitalet de Llobregat
displayName: l'Hospitalet de Llobregat, Barcelonès, Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain

summary.extract: L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, known in Spanish as Hospitalet de Llobregat, literally "The little Hospital of Llobregat", often shortened to L'Hospitalet or just L'H, is a city and municipality in the autonomous community of Catalonia in Spain. It is part of the Barcelona metropolitan area, the Barcelona province, the Barcelonès comarca and of the Barcelona conurbation. With a population of 292,161 as of 2025, it is the 15th-largest city in Spain and the 2nd-largest city in Catalonia. It is one of the most densely populated cities in the European Union.
